reply.text:
Avoiding a whole food group out of fear is something to talk through with a doctor or a registered dietitian, not a coach. I'm not going to build workouts around eating no carbs, because I don't want to help set up training on top of that. Once you've talked it through with one of them, I'm glad to build you a program and work out what training fits.

If you want, we can keep going on the training side in the meantime. Tell me what you've been doing lately and how you'd like to train.
